title: Nepal floods: Their loved ones are gone. The law says they are missing

blocks.text: Purna Ghale, a resident of Khalte in Rasuwa, survived the August 26 floods but many of his family members remain missing since the disaster—his father, eldest son, daughter-in-law, younger brother, two granddaughters and three sons-in-law. With none of their bodies recovered, they are all but presumed dead. Without a body, there is no death certificate.
